chose: `sofar drive` defaults to `--lanes auto`: with no --lanes, a run that is not --resume, --cwd or the threshold policy, inside a git repo, drives min(3, ready tasks) lanes when at least 2 tasks are ready, and serial otherwise; `--lanes N` always wins and `--lanes 1` forces serial; `--hosted cloud` resolves the same count locally and hands the cloud driver an explicit --lanes.
